class.name: CgameSmartObjects
class.brief_description: Smart Object registry with slots, exclusive claims, interaction graphs and automatic placement.
class.description: Native port of the Cgame GDScript Smart Object registry, inspired by the public concept of Unreal Engine's Smart Objects. It provides slots, exclusive claims with idle timeouts, query scoring, placement scoring / deterministic automatic placement and per-behavior interaction step graphs. An object is a [Dictionary] [code]{id: String, position: Vector3, tags: Array, slots: [{offset: Vector3, behavior: String, tags: Array}]}[/code]. Positions are world [Vector3]; 2D areas ([Rect2]) map [code]x[/code] to world [code]x[/code] and [code]y[/code] to world [code]z[/code]. A behavior is an array of steps [code]{anim: String, duration: float, effect: String}[/code]. [b]Query:[/b] [method find] takes [code]{position, radius, required_tags, preferred_tags, behavior, include_claimed}[/code] and returns [code][{object, slot, position, distance, score}][/code], best score first (ties: object id, then slot index). The score is [code]1 - distance / radius[/code] plus the fraction of [code]preferred_tags[/code] present on the object or slot. [b]Claims:[/b] [method claim] returns a handle greater than zero, or [code]0[/code] when the slot is unavailable. An idle claim expires after its timeout unless [method touch] is called; a timeout of [code]0[/code] never expires.

method.name: advance
method.description: Advances interactions and claim timeouts by [param dt] seconds. Returns the handles of interactions that finished during this call. Finished claims are released when [member release_on_complete] is enabled; claims that are not interacting expire when their timeout elapses.

method.name: auto_place
method.description: Deterministic automatic placement of up to [param count] objects inside [param area] using a [RandomNumberGenerator] seeded with [param rng_seed]. [param rules] is [code]{min_spacing, density, nav_reachable: Callable, candidates: int}[/code] ([code]candidates[/code] is the number of samples per object). Returns [Vector3] positions with [code]y = 0[/code]; objects without any valid sample are skipped.

method.name: claim
method.description: Claims a slot exclusively for [param user]. Returns a handle greater than zero, or [code]0[/code] when the object or slot does not exist or the slot is already claimed. A negative [param timeout] uses [member default_claim_timeout]; [code]0[/code] never expires.

method.name: claim_user
method.description: Returns the user of a claim, or [code]null[/code] for an unknown handle.

method.name: find
method.description: Finds slots matching [param query] and returns them ranked best first. See the class description for the query and result layout.

method.name: get_object
method.description: Returns a copy of the registered object (with [code]tags[/code] and [code]slots[/code] defaults filled in), or an empty dictionary.

method.name: has_object
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an object with [param id] is registered.

method.name: interaction_state
method.description: Returns [code]{step, anim, t, duration}[/code] of the current interaction step, or an empty dictionary when the claim is not interacting.

method.name: is_claimed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param handle] refers to a live claim.

method.name: is_slot_free
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the slot is not claimed.

method.name: object_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered objects.

method.name: placement_score
method.description: Returns a score in [code][0, 1][/code] for putting a new object at [param candidate_pos]. The score is [code]0[/code] when [param nav_reachable] (a [code]Callable(Vector3) -> bool[/code], optional) rejects the position or when it is closer than [param min_spacing] to a registered object or a position in [param placed]. [param density] is the number of neighbours within [code]2.5 * min_spacing[/code] that are tolerated before the score falls off; the score never drops below [code]0.05[/code] once valid.

method.name: register_behavior
method.description: Registers the interaction steps of [param behavior]. Each step is [code]{anim, duration, effect}[/code]; a non-empty [code]effect[/code] is reported to [member on_effect] when the step is entered.

method.name: register_object
method.description: Registers (or replaces) an object. Returns [code]false[/code] when [code]id[/code] or [code]position[/code] is missing or the position is not a [Vector3]. The dictionary is copied.

method.name: release
method.description: Releases a claim. Returns [code]false[/code] for an unknown handle (a double release is a no-op).

method.name: slot_position
method.description: Returns the world position of a slot of [param object]: the object position plus the slot offset.

method.name: start_interaction
method.description: Starts the behavior steps of the claimed slot. Returns [code]false[/code] for an unknown handle or a slot whose behavior has no registered steps.

method.name: touch
method.description: Resets the idle timeout of a claim (the user is still on its way).

method.name: unregister_object
method.description: Removes an object and releases all of its claims.

members.member: Idle timeout in seconds of claims created without an explicit timeout.
Called as [code](effect: String, user: Variant, object_id: String)[/code] when an interaction enters a step with an effect.
If [code]true[/code], a claim is released as soon as its interaction finishes.
